summary.notice: Public Telegram preview posts and public RSS/Atom headlines/excerpts only. All items are unverified source leads; publication time is not incident time. Repeated coverage is not independent corroboration. This feed excludes analyst notes and incident decisions.
summary.archive_notice: Daily rolling archive merged from scheduled public-source collection runs. Coverage is bounded by public preview/RSS access and collector limits; this is not a complete record of all posts or news.

Night and morning strikes on energy and industrial sites near the contact line Chernigov Oblast: Three jet drones hit Mashеvo 110 kV substation; no confirmed damage. Sumy Oblast: Two Geran-2 drones struck Putivl 110 kV substation, damaging switchgear. A drone hit Glukhov 110 kV substation. Kharkov Oblast: Fires at Kutuzovka (1200 m²) and Shevchenkovo Vtoroye farms. Two attacks damaged Lozovaya 330 kV substation equipment. Stepovaya 330 kV substation in Zlatopol was hit twice, causing a fire and cutting power to over 300,000 users. AD debris burned stalls at Zlatopol market. Kalugino-Bashkirovka mineral water plant, Malinovka liquor factory, and Chuguev food goods plant were hit by Geran-2 drones, causing significant storage fires. Donetsk Oblast: An FAB-250 glide bomb destroyed the Kramatorsk district prosecutor's office building. @Slavyangrad
